chapter_title_en: Storms Stir Beyond the Seas, An Unforeseen Peril
chapter_seo_title: The Ghost Mist Arrives! Han Li vs. Wen Tianren’s Attrition War Ends in Chaos
og_title: The Ghost Mist Arrives! Cultivators Fall
og_description: The battle between Han Li and Wen Tianren is interrupted as a terrifying Ghost Mist sweeps in, stripping every cultivator of their power.
twitter_title: No One Flies Today! The Ghost Mist Strips All Cultivators of Power
twitter_description: Wen Tianren’s golden flames fail to kill Han Li, but before a new fight can begin, a supernatural mist disables all flying magic, causing everyone to fall.

lore_anchors.definition: A mobile, semi-sentient environmental hazard that appears as a living black fog; it nullifies spiritual energy, causing cultivators to lose flight and mana.
The Ten-Thousand-Year Spirit Liquid produced by the Heaven Vial; an extremely rare substance that can instantly restore a cultivator's mana.
A high-grade magic treasure that produces a golden flame barrier; it is powerful but requires a massive, continuous drain on the user's mana.
A forbidden Yin-aligned resurrection technique that requires intense concentration to cast, making the caster vulnerable.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Wen Tianren suddenly order Zi Ling to capture Yuan Yao?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is desperate; his mana is depleted and the golden flames aren't working, so he resorts to a hostage tactic to force Han Li's hand.
